# visualization.heatmaps.correlation_map { #fmrimod.visualization.heatmaps.correlation_map }

```python
correlation_map(
    model,
    rotate_x_text=True,
    method='pearson',
    half_matrix=True,
    limits='fixed',
    annotate=None,
    flag_threshold=0.5,
    vif_threshold=5.0,
    title=None,
    subtitle=None,
    caption=None,
    within_run=None,
    figsize=None,
    ax=None,
    annot=None,
)
```

Pairwise regressor correlations as a lower triangle (R ``correlation_map``).

The fill is the diverging palette fixed at [-1, 1] with a neutral zero;
up to 20 columns each cell also prints r (two decimals up to 10
columns). Cells with ``|r| >= flag_threshold`` are outlined and counted
in the subtitle, which also names the most correlated pair. Pairwise
correlations miss multicollinearity, so the diagonal shows each
column's variance inflation factor with per-run intercepts
(`design_vif`); VIFs at or
above ``vif_threshold`` and aliased columns are flagged in the warning
colour. Columns keep design order and are grouped by term, so the map
lines up with `design_map`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                              | Default     |
|----------------|------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| model          | (EventModel, BaselineModel or FmriModel) |                                                                                                                                                                                          | _required_  |
| rotate_x_text  | bool                                     | Angle column labels when they would overlap.                                                                                                                                             | `True`      |
| method         | (\'pearson\', \'spearman\')              | Correlation method (VIFs are always linear).                                                                                                                                             | `"pearson"` |
| half_matrix    | bool                                     | Lower triangle only (default) or every off-diagonal cell.                                                                                                                                | `True`      |
| limits         | (\'fixed\', \'data\')                    | Fill over [-1, 1], or symmetric up to the largest ``\|r\|``.                                                                                                                             | `"fixed"`   |
| annotate       | bool                                     | Print r in the cells; default when there are at most 20 columns (12 for a baseline model). ``annot`` is an alias.                                                                        | `None`      |
| flag_threshold | float                                    | Outline cells at or above this ``\|r\|``; flag VIFs at or above this.                                                                                                                    | `0.5`       |
| vif_threshold  | float                                    | Outline cells at or above this ``\|r\|``; flag VIFs at or above this.                                                                                                                    | `0.5`       |
| within_run     | bool                                     | Correlate within runs with run intercepts removed (see `design_correlations`). Defaults to ``True`` for a baseline model, ``False`` otherwise. | `None`      |
| title          | str                                      | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                                                                            | `None`      |
| subtitle       | str                                      | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                                                                            | `None`      |
| caption        | str                                      | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                                                                            | `None`      |
| figsize        | (float, float)                           |                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`      |
| ax             | matplotlib Axes                          |                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description   |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------|
|        | matplotlib.figure.Figure |               |
